_comment: STARTING gain seed for the 5in racer (650 g, 220 mm, 2400KV/3S, 5x4.3x3). NOT a tune -- a defensible starting point pending bench sysid. Derived by converting ArduPilot's multirotor defaults (AC_ATC_MULTI_RATE_RP_P/I/D 0.135/0.135/0.0036) into vayu units: AP takes rate error in rad/s and emits normalised torque, vayu takes deg/s and emits per-motor duty differential directly, so vayu_gain = ap_gain * cos(45deg) * pi/180 = ap_gain * 0.012341. ROLL AND PITCH ARE EQUAL on purpose: the firmware defaults carry an asymmetry (roll ki 0.00811 vs pitch 0.003) inherited from the 10in S500, whose measured pitch K was 2.45x its roll. This frame has no such measured asymmetry, so starting it symmetric is the honest default. Note AP's defaults target a ~450-class quad; this frame's control effectiveness is estimated ~8.6x higher, which argues these are an UPPER bound. Apply with tools/sysid/apply_tune.py; NOT persisted on the FC, re-apply after each boot.
airframe: 5in racer, 650 g AUW, 220 mm wheelbase, 2400KV on 3S, 5x4.3x3

angle_pid._comment: controller=0 (angle). Left at the firmware default 3.0 -- AP's angle P is a different formulation and does not convert cleanly. Reduce it FIRST if the craft oscillates in angle mode; the S500 needed 4.14 -> 1.75.
